premises.text: Online connections and word-of-mouth power can help resolve complaints with local service providers
premises.evidence_span: Our app takes a resource that all of us have, which is our online connections, our online clout, our word-of-mouth power, and puts it in the palm of our hands so that we can use it to get our complaints resolved on the spot with local service providers.

premises.text: The app is free and requires no registration
premises.evidence_span: Gripe is a free app. It's available on Android and iPhone platforms. There's no registration required.

premises.text: The app calculates a reach and influence number based on social media connections
premises.evidence_span: It summarizes all of it in a reach and influence number, and we calculate that like this. Reach is your friends and followers on Twitter and Facebook. Influence is those you can influence through your friends and followers on Twitter and Facebook.

premises.text: The app allows users to submit complaints and share them with their social network
premises.evidence_span: you can hit start a Gripe. We ask you what happened. We allow the ad photos from your camera or from the library, soon from video as well.

premises.text: Merchants receive notifications about public complaints and have the opportunity to resolve them
premises.evidence_span: we go back to the merchants, and we send them an email saying, hey, this is a Gripe, a public complaint that's been started.

premises.text: Resolving complaints can turn detractors into positive customers
premises.evidence_span: when the customer marks the Gripe as resolved, the top of this screen becomes green.

value.text: Complaints can be resolved effectively through social influence and local service provider engagement
value.evidence_span: the idea is to take every Gripe and have it be resolved.

notes: No external knowledge or traction metrics included.
